 It is easy to get caught up in Luka Doncic carrying the Los Angeles Lakers in the 2026-27 NBA season. The numbers speak for themselves, as he is scoring almost 40 points every night while still facilitating for his team.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Doncic had another awesome game on Tuesday for the Lakers , scoring 36 points. However, he was not the biggest standout because Quentin Grimes scored 47 points with 10 made three-pointers, including a clutch three to send the game to overtime.
 The Lakers recognized Quentin Grimes' hot hand in comeback victory
 The Charlotte Hornets tried their very best to get the win, but they could not secure the victory. At the same time, the Hornets had players with minutes restrictions , so Brandon Miller and Coby White missed out on a big opportunity.
 However, the main story of the game was Grimes, who had the best game of his career. It was a magical night that helped the Lakers to get their ninth straight win, the longest active winning streak in the league, and they are now the Western Conference's top team.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement MORE: Quentin Grimes feels honored to be in the same record books as Kobe Bryant 
 As the Lakers' head coach, Redick wanted to keep running his tried-and-true offense centered on Doncic. However, Doncic recognized Grimes was too hot to keep running the same plays.
 "Obviously, Quentin Grimes had an unbelievable night. Aggressive throughout, shot making was ridiculous, not a bigger shot than the one that sent it to overtime... Luka when he got back in the game in the 4th he kept calling off every play I was calling and just saying he's trying to get Q the ball, like he recognized what was happening," Redick said about Doncic and the Lakers' offense in the fourth quarter .
 Now, the Lakers are riding high with their winning streak and renewed motivation. They were down big against the Hornets , but they showed an ability to get through adversity and still win games. It is a massive result for the Lakers that will have its ripple effects for the rest of the season.
